notes: Fabric's meta API publishes no checksum for the composed loader/installer/server-jar endpoint (unlike Mojang/Paper/Purpur), so checksum.matches_provider_published is null -- there is nothing to compare against, only a locally computed sha256 for reference. The downloaded jar is Fabric's own small bootstrap jar (182 KB), not a full server jar; it resolves the rest of the classpath from its own embedded libraries at boot, which is why this Done time is close to vanilla's despite sharing the same resolved MC version.
